name: application-achievement-toast
title: Achievement Toast
description: Unlocked-achievement popup components with an icon, title, and rarity glow, for gamified apps and progress systems.
useWhen: Unlocked-achievement popup components with an icon, title, and rarity glow, for gamified apps and progress systems.
avoidWhen: Avoid achievement toast when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Achievement Toast uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
